questions: What threshold defines 'small values'? (e.g., less than 10, less than or equal to 10, less than 5, etc.)
Should the replacement be applied element-wise to all numeric values, or only to values in specific columns?
Is the random integer generation inclusive of both endpoints (1 and 100)?
Should the replacement occur before or after any potential rounding or type conversion of the random values?
If a value is exactly equal to the threshold (e.g., 10 if threshold is <10), should it be replaced?
Should the function handle non-integer random values (e.g., floats) if parameters change?
Is the seed parameter applied only to the random number generation, or also to any other random processes?
Should the replacement preserve the original data type of the DataFrame (e.g., int), or can it change (e.g., to float if -1 is mixed with ints)?
